main_body: Dresser body: a top surface carrying a bottle, books and a red box, then a front with four inset drawers, and a dark base
top_band: Mid orange-brown band at rows 6-11 (about 6 rows) with props standing on it, then a lighter orange front-edge line at rows 12-13
evidence: In the middle column, rows 6-11 form a horizontal top surface with items standing on it. Rows 12-13 are a lighter front-edge line, and row 14 is a dark eave shadow. Rows 15-29 are the front face, with drawers inset by dark dividers and lighter upper borders, above a dark base. The top is about 6 rows against a 15-row front, which is clearly more than a rim, so it reads as 3/4. The top is close in tone to the front, but the edge line and the props sitting on it separate them.

style.evidence: The ramps have about 4 steps: light orange edge, mid orange, tan drawer border, dark brown. The outline is a dark brown matching the wood, so it is not near-black. The drawer panels and the top are large flat single-colour areas of roughly 10x6 px, with no grain, knots or speckle. The only detail is the small handles and the props. The Beodeul stall and well references carry much more texture and tone variation per tile, so this piece looks flatter and thinner next to them.
